Duplicate detection settings
🤖
How it works: Compares every contact pair using fuzzy name matching, email similarity, and phone number matching. Exact email or phone matches are flagged as High confidence. Similar names with partial contact info match are Medium or Low. You review each pair and decide to keep one or merge both records.

Help

BoldTrail Import Guide

Step-by-step guide for importing your converted CSV into BoldTrail.

1
Search for Bulk Import in BoldTrail

Click the search bar and type Bulk Import. Under Features, click Lead Engine › Bulk Import.

2
Upload your converted CSV

Drag and drop your boldtrail_import.csv or click Browse Files.

3
Accept terms and click Next

Check I understand and click Next.

4
Verify field matching: 14 of 14

You should see 14 of 14 MATCHED with a full green bar.

5
Confirm opt-in fields

Scroll to Opt in (subscribe). Verify email_optin, phone_on, and text_on are mapped.

6
Review and finish

Check how many contacts import. Toggle Import anyway for duplicates if needed, then Finish.
